{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the sentinel revenue values
sentinel_revenue = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Print the number of such rows
print(f'Number of rows with sentinel revenue (999999.99): {len(sentinel_revenue)}')

# Also check the distribution of revenue values to confirm if any look like outliers
print('\nTop 5 revenue values (as strings):')
print(df['revenue'].value_counts().head(5))"}
